195	    def _forward_micro_batch(
196	        self, micro_batch, temperature, calculate_entropy=False
197	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
198	        """
199	        Returns:
200	            entropy: # (bs, response_len)
201	            log_probs: # (bs, response_len)
202	        """
203	        response_length = micro_batch["responses"].size(-1)
204	        multi_modal_inputs = {}
205	        if "multi_modal_inputs" in micro_batch.keys():
206	            from verl.utils.model import extract_multi_modal_inputs
207	
208	            multi_modal_inputs = extract_multi_modal_inputs(micro_batch["multi_modal_inputs"])
209	
210	        with torch.autocast(device_type=self.device_name, dtype=self.param_dtype):
211	            input_ids = micro_batch["input_ids"]
212	            batch_size, seqlen = input_ids.shape
213	            attention_mask = micro_batch["attention_mask"]
214	            position_ids = micro_batch["position_ids"]
215	            entropy = None
216	            if position_ids.dim() == 3:  # qwen2vl mrope
217	                position_ids = position_ids.transpose(0, 1)  # (bsz, 4, seqlen) -> (4, bsz, seqlen)
218	
219	            if self.use_remove_padding:
220	                input_ids_rmpad, indices, cu_seqlens, *_ = unpad_input(
221	                    input_ids.unsqueeze(-1), attention_mask
222	                )  # input_ids_rmpad (total_nnz, ...)
223	                input_ids_rmpad = input_ids_rmpad.transpose(0, 1)  # (1, total_nnz)
224	
225	                # unpad the position_ids to align the rotary
226	                if position_ids.dim() == 3:
227	                    position_ids_rmpad = (
228	                        index_first_axis(rearrange(position_ids, "c b s ... -> (b s) c ..."), indices)
229	                        .transpose(0, 1)
230	                        .unsqueeze(1)
231	                    )  # (4, bsz, seqlen) -> (4, 1, bsz * seqlen)
232	                else:
233	                    position_ids_rmpad = index_first_axis(
234	                        rearrange(position_ids.unsqueeze(-1), "b s ... -> (b s) ..."), indices
235	                    ).transpose(0, 1)
236	
237	                is_mask_all_zero = attention_mask.sum() == 0
238	                if is_mask_all_zero:
239	                    input_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(
240	                        (1, self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size),
241	                        device=input_ids.device,
242	                        dtype=input_ids.dtype,
243	                    )
244	                    if position_ids.dim() == 3:
245	                        position_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(
246	                            (position_ids.shape[0], 1, self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size),
247	                            device=position_ids.device,
248	                            dtype=position_ids.dtype,
249	                        )
250	                    else:
251	                        position_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(
252	                            (1, self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size),
253	                            device=position_ids.device,
254	                            dtype=position_ids.dtype,
255	                        )
256	
257	                if "image_bound" in multi_modal_inputs:
258	                    from verl.utils.dataset.vision_utils import process_multi_modal_inputs_for_minicpmo
259	
260	                    multi_modal_inputs = process_multi_modal_inputs_for_minicpmo(
261	                        input_ids, attention_mask, position_ids, cu_seqlens, multi_modal_inputs
262	                    )
263	
264	                # for compute the log_prob
265	                input_ids_rmpad_rolled = torch.roll(input_ids_rmpad, shifts=-1, dims=1)  # (1, total_nnz)
266	
267	                # pad and slice the inputs if sp > 1
268	                if self.use_ulysses_sp:
269	                    is_vlm_model = hasattr(
270	                        getattr(self.actor_module, "module", self.actor_module).config, "vision_config"
271	                    )
272	                    if is_vlm_model:
273	                        # vlm model's inputs will be sliced after embedding
274	                        input_ids_rmpad, position_ids_rmpad, pad_size = ulysses_pad(
275	                            input_ids_rmpad,
276	                            position_ids_rmpad=position_ids_rmpad,
277	                            sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size,
278	                        )
279	                    else:
280	                        input_ids_rmpad, position_ids_rmpad, pad_size = ulysses_pad_and_slice_inputs(
281	                            input_ids_rmpad,
282	                            position_ids_rmpad=position_ids_rmpad,
283	                            sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size,
284	                        )
285	                    input_ids_rmpad_rolled, _, _ = ulysses_pad_and_slice_inputs(
286	                        input_ids_rmpad_rolled,
287	                        position_ids_rmpad=None,
288	                        sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size,
289	                    )
290	
291	                input_ids_rmpad_rolled = input_ids_rmpad_rolled.squeeze(0)  # ((total_nnz / sp) + pad)
292	
293	                # only pass input_ids and position_ids to enable flash_attn_varlen
294	                extra_args = {}
295	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
296	                    extra_args["temperature"] = temperature
297	                    extra_args["return_dict"] = True
298	
299	                output = self.actor_module(
300	                    input_ids=input_ids_rmpad,
301	                    attention_mask=None,
302	                    position_ids=position_ids_rmpad,
303	                    **multi_modal_inputs,
304	                    use_cache=False,
305	                    **extra_args,
306	                )  # prevent model thinks we are generating
307	
308	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
309	                    log_probs = output.log_probs.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz,)
310	                    entropy_rmpad = output.entropy.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz,)
311	
312	                else:
313	                    logits_rmpad = output.logits.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz, vocab_size)
314	                    logits_rmpad.div_(temperature)
315	
316	                    # if use_sp: ((total_nnz / sp) + pad) ; if not use_sp: (batch, seqlen)
317	                    inplace_backward = True
318	                    if calculate_entropy:
319	                        inplace_backward = False
320	                    log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(
321	                        logits=logits_rmpad,
322	                        labels=input_ids_rmpad_rolled,
323	                        inplace_backward=inplace_backward,
324	                    )
325	
326	                    # compute entropy
327	                    if calculate_entropy:
328	                        if not self.config.entropy_checkpointing:
329	                            entropy_rmpad = self.compute_entropy_from_logits(logits_rmpad)  # ((total_nnz / sp) + pad)
330	                        else:
331	                            entropy_rmpad = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(
332	                                self.compute_entropy_from_logits, logits_rmpad
333	                            )
334	
335	                # gather log_prob if sp > 1
336	                if self.use_ulysses_sp:
337	                    # gather and unpad for the ulysses sp
338	                    log_probs = gather_outputs_and_unpad(
339	                        log_probs,
340	                        gather_dim=0,
341	                        unpad_dim=0,
342	                        padding_size=pad_size,
343	                    )
344	                    if calculate_entropy:
345	                        entropy_rmpad = gather_outputs_and_unpad(
346	                            entropy_rmpad,
347	                            gather_dim=0,
348	                            unpad_dim=0,
349	                            padding_size=pad_size,
350	                        )
351	
352	                if is_mask_all_zero:
353	                    log_probs = log_probs[:0]
354	                    if calculate_entropy:
355	                        entropy_rmpad = entropy_rmpad[:0]
356	
357	                # pad back to (bsz, seqlen)
358	                if calculate_entropy:
359	                    full_entropy = pad_input(
360	                        hidden_states=entropy_rmpad.unsqueeze(-1),
361	                        indices=indices,
362	                        batch=batch_size,
363	                        seqlen=seqlen,
364	                    )
365	                full_log_probs = pad_input(
366	                    hidden_states=log_probs.unsqueeze(-1),
367	                    indices=indices,
368	                    batch=batch_size,
369	                    seqlen=seqlen,
370	                )
371	
372	                # only return response part:
373	                if calculate_entropy:
374	                    entropy = full_entropy.squeeze(-1)[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
375	                log_probs = full_log_probs.squeeze(-1)[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
376	
377	            else:  # not using rmpad and no ulysses sp
378	                extra_args = {}
379	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
380	                    extra_args["temperature"] = temperature
381	                    extra_args["return_dict"] = True
382	
383	                output = self.actor_module(
384	                    input_ids=input_ids,
385	                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
386	                    position_ids=position_ids,
387	                    **multi_modal_inputs,
388	                    use_cache=False,
389	                    **extra_args,
390	                )  # prevent model thinks we are generating
391	
392	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
393	                    log_probs = output.log_probs[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]
394	                    entropy = output.entropy[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
395	
396	                else:
397	                    logits = output.logits
398	
399	                    logits.div_(temperature)
400	                    logits = logits[:, -response_length - 1 : -1, :]  # (bsz, response_length, vocab_size)
401	                    log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(logits, micro_batch["responses"])
402	                    if calculate_entropy:
403	                        if not self.config.entropy_checkpointing:
404	                            entropy = verl_F.entropy_from_logits(logits)  # (bsz, response_length)
405	                        else:
406	                            entropy = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(verl_F.entropy_from_logits, logits)
407	
408	            return entropy, log_probs
409	
410	    def _optimizer_step(self):
411	        assert self.config.grad_clip is not None
412	        if self.scaler is not None:
413	            self.scaler.unscale_(self.actor_optimizer)
414	        if isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDP):
415	            grad_norm = self.actor_module.clip_grad_norm_(max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
416	        elif isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDPModule):
417	            grad_norm = fsdp2_clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_module.parameters(), max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
418	        else:
419	            grad_norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_module.parameters(), max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
420	
421	        if isinstance(grad_norm, DTensor):
422	            grad_norm = grad_norm.full_tensor()
423	
424	        # if grad_norm is not finite, skip the update
425	        if self.scaler is not None:
426	            self.scaler.step(self.actor_optimizer)
427	            self.scaler.update()
428	        else:
429	            if not torch.isfinite(grad_norm):
430	                print(f"WARN: rank {torch.distributed.get_rank()} grad_norm is not finite: {grad_norm}")
431	                self.actor_optimizer.zero_grad()
432	            else:
433	                self.actor_optimizer.step()
434	
435	        peft_model = getattr(self.actor_module, "_fsdp_wrapped_module", self.actor_module)
436	        peft_config = getattr(getattr(peft_model, "peft_config", {}), "get", lambda *_: None)("default")
437	        if peft_config is not None and str(getattr(peft_config, "peft_type", "")).endswith("ADALORA"):
438	            init_r = getattr(peft_config, "init_r", None)
439	            target_r = getattr(peft_config, "target_r", None)
440	            should_allocate = init_r is None or target_r is None or target_r < init_r
441	            if should_allocate:
442	                missing_grad_count = 0
443	                for name, param in peft_model.named_parameters():
444	                    if "lora_" in name and ".default" in name and param.grad is None:
445	                        # AdaLoRA rank allocation reads gradients even after optimizer.step().
446	                        param.grad = torch.zeros_like(param)
447	                        missing_grad_count += 1
448	                if missing_grad_count and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
449	                    print(f"Filled {missing_grad_count} missing AdaLoRA grads with zeros before rank allocation.")
450	                peft_model.base_model.update_and_allocate(self._adalora_step)
451	                self._adalora_step += 1
452	            elif self._adalora_step == 0 and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
453	                print("Skipping AdaLoRA rank allocation because target_r >= init_r; rank schedule is a no-op.")
454	                self._adalora_step += 1
455	        return grad_norm

457	    @GPUMemoryLogger(role="dp actor", logger=logger)
458	    def compute_log_prob(self, data: DataProto, calculate_entropy=False) -> torch.Tensor:
459	        if not hasattr(self, "_debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once"):
460	            self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once = False
461	        """Compute the log probability of the responses given input_ids, attention_mask and position_ids
462	
463	        Args:
464	            data (DataProto): a DataProto containing keys
465	
466	                ``input_ids``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64. Note that input_ids is the
467	                concatenation of prompt and response. Note that ``sequence_length = prompt_length + response_length``.
468	
469	                ``attention_mask``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64.
470	
471	                ``position_ids``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64.
472	
473	                ``responses``:  tensor of shape [batch_size, response_length]. torch.int64.
474	
475	        Returns:
476	            torch.Tensor: the log_prob tensor
477	        """
478	        # set to eval
479	        self.actor_module.eval()
480	        if not self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
481	            _write_actor_policy_debug(
482	                "actor_compute_log_prob",
483	                {
484	                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
485	                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
486	                    **_actor_adapter_state_payload(self.actor_module),
487	                },
488	            )
489	            self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once = True
490	
491	        micro_batch_size = data.meta_info["micro_batch_size"]
492	        temperature = data.meta_info["temperature"]  # temperature must be in the data.meta_info to avoid silent error
493	        use_dynamic_bsz = data.meta_info["use_dynamic_bsz"]
494	        has_multi_modal_inputs = "multi_modal_inputs" in data.non_tensor_batch.keys()
495	        select_keys = ["responses", "input_ids", "attention_mask", "position_ids"]
496	        non_tensor_select_keys = ["multi_modal_inputs"] if has_multi_modal_inputs else []
497	
498	        data = data.select(batch_keys=select_keys, non_tensor_batch_keys=non_tensor_select_keys)
499	
500	        if use_dynamic_bsz:
501	            max_token_len = data.meta_info["max_token_len"] * self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size
502	            micro_batches, batch_idx_list = prepare_dynamic_batch(data, max_token_len=max_token_len)
503	        else:
504	            micro_batches = data.split(micro_batch_size)
505	
506	        log_probs_lst = []
507	        entropy_lst = []
508	        for micro_batch in micro_batches:
509	            micro_batch = micro_batch.to(get_device_id())
510	            model_inputs = {**micro_batch.batch, **micro_batch.non_tensor_batch}
511	            with torch.no_grad():
512	                entropy, log_probs = self._forward_micro_batch(
513	                    model_inputs, temperature=temperature, calculate_entropy=calculate_entropy
514	                )
515	            log_probs_lst.append(log_probs)
516	            if calculate_entropy:
517	                entropy_lst.append(entropy)
518	
519	        log_probs = torch.concat(log_probs_lst, dim=0)
520	        entropys = None
521	        if calculate_entropy:
522	            entropys = torch.concat(entropy_lst, dim=0)
523	
524	        if use_dynamic_bsz:
525	            log_probs = restore_dynamic_batch(log_probs, batch_idx_list)
526	            if calculate_entropy:
527	                entropys = restore_dynamic_batch(entropys, batch_idx_list)
528	
529	        return log_probs, entropys

531	    def _maybe_dump_full_grads(self) -> None:
532	        dump_path = os.getenv("VERL_FULL_GRAD_DUMP_PATH")
533	        if not dump_path or self._grad_dump_done or not isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDP):
534	            return
535	
536	        requested = os.getenv("VERL_FULL_GRAD_LAYERS", "").strip()
537	        selected = {name.strip() for name in requested.split(",") if name.strip()}
538	        grad_tensors = {}
539	
540	        with FSDP.summon_full_params(self.actor_module, writeback=False, with_grads=True):
541	            for name, param in self.actor_module.named_parameters():
542	                if not name.endswith(".weight"):
543	                    continue
544	                if selected and name not in selected:
545	                    continue
546	                if param.grad is None:
547	                    continue
548	                grad_tensors[name] = param.grad.detach().cpu().float().clone()
549	
550	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
551	            parent = os.path.dirname(dump_path)
552	            if parent:
553	                os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
554	            torch.save(grad_tensors, dump_path)
555	            print(f"Saved {len(grad_tensors)} full gradients to {dump_path}")
556	
557	        torch.distributed.barrier()
558	        self._grad_dump_done = True

560	    @GPUMemoryLogger(role="dp actor", logger=logger)
561	    def update_policy(self, data: DataProto):
562	        # make sure we are in training mode
563	        self.actor_module.train()
564	        if not hasattr(self, "_debug_actor_update_policy_once"):
565	            self._debug_actor_update_policy_once = False
566	        if not self._debug_actor_update_policy_once and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
567	            _write_actor_policy_debug(
568	                "actor_update_policy",
569	                {
570	                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
571	                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
572	                    **_actor_adapter_state_payload(self.actor_module),
573	                },
574	            )
575	            self._debug_actor_update_policy_once = True
576	
577	        temperature = data.meta_info["temperature"]  # temperature must be in the data.meta_info to avoid silent error
578	
579	        select_keys = [
580	            "responses",
581	            "response_mask",
582	            "input_ids",
583	            "attention_mask",
584	            "position_ids",
585	            "old_log_probs",
586	            "advantages",
587	        ]
588	        if self.config.use_kl_loss:
589	            select_keys.append("ref_log_prob")
590	        safe_base_ref_log_prob = None
591	        if "base_ref_log_prob" in data.batch.keys():
592	            # TensorDict.select() corrupts this tensor in the current training path,
593	            # so carry a materialized copy across the selection boundary.
594	            safe_base_ref_log_prob = data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"].clone().contiguous()
595	        # Include pre-computed IS weights if present in batch
596	        # Weights are computed centrally in trainer and added to batch when algorithm.rollout_is=True
597	        if "rollout_is_weights" in data.batch.keys():
598	            select_keys.append("rollout_is_weights")
599	        # Include rollout_log_probs for computing rollout_corr metrics in bypass mode
600	        if "rollout_log_probs" in data.batch.keys():
601	            select_keys.append("rollout_log_probs")
602	
603	        has_multi_modal_inputs = "multi_modal_inputs" in data.non_tensor_batch.keys()
604	        non_tensor_select_keys = ["multi_modal_inputs"] if has_multi_modal_inputs else []
605	
606	        data = data.select(batch_keys=select_keys, non_tensor_batch_keys=non_tensor_select_keys)
607	        if safe_base_ref_log_prob is not None:
608	            data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"] = safe_base_ref_log_prob
609	        if (
610	            not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
611	            and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
612	            and "base_ref_log_prob" in data.batch.keys()
613	        ):
614	            _write_base_kl_debug(
615	                "actor_update_probe_after_select",
616	                {
617	                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
618	                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
619	                    **_base_ref_probe_payload(
620	                        "after_select",
621	                        data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"],
622	                        data.batch.get("old_log_probs"),
623	                    ),
624	                },
625	            )
626	
627	        # Split to make minibatch iterator for updating the actor
628	        # See PPO paper for details. https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347
629	        mini_batches = data.split(self.config.ppo_mini_batch_size)
630	
631	        on_policy = len(mini_batches) == 1 and self.config.ppo_epochs == 1
632	
633	        metrics = {}
634	        for _ in range(self.config.ppo_epochs):
635	            for batch_idx, mini_batch in enumerate(mini_batches):
636	                if (
637	                    not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
638	                    and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
639	                    and "base_ref_log_prob" in mini_batch.batch.keys()
640	                ):
641	                    _write_base_kl_debug(
642	                        "actor_update_probe_mini_batch",
643	                        {
644	                            "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
645	                            "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
646	                            "mini_batch_idx": int(batch_idx),
647	                            **_base_ref_probe_payload(

def _debug_base_kl_payload(old_log_prob: torch.Tensor, base_ref_log_prob: torch.Tensor, response_mask: torch.Tensor) -> dict:
    diff = torch.clamp(old_log_prob - base_ref_log_prob, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    seq_den = response_mask.sum(dim=-1).clamp_min(1)
    seq_base_kl = (-diff * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / seq_den
    return {
        "old_mean": float(old_log_prob.mean().item()),
        "base_ref_mean": float(base_ref_log_prob.mean().item()),
        "diff_mean": float(diff.mean().item()),
        "diff_abs_mean": float(diff.abs().mean().item()),
        "masked_base_kl": float(verl_F.masked_mean(-diff, response_mask).item()),
        "response_mask_sum": float(response_mask.sum().item()),
        "seq_base_kl_head": seq_base_kl[:8].detach().cpu().tolist(),
    }


def _write_base_kl_debug(stage: str, payload: dict) -> str:
    out_dir = os.getenv(
        "VERL_BASE_KL_DEBUG_DIR",
        "./outputs/base_kl_debug",
    )
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    exp_name = str(payload.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp"))
    path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{exp_name}.{stage}.rank{payload.get('rank', 'x')}.json")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
    return path


def _write_actor_policy_debug(stage: str, payload: dict) -> str:

def _actor_adapter_state_payload(peft_model, extra: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    active_adapters = []
    if peft_model is not None:
        active_adapters_attr = getattr(peft_model, "active_adapters", [])
        if callable(active_adapters_attr):
            try:
                active_adapters_attr = active_adapters_attr()
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                active_adapters_attr = []
        if active_adapters_attr is None:
            active_adapters = []
        elif isinstance(active_adapters_attr, str):
            active_adapters = [active_adapters_attr]
        else:
            try:
                active_adapters = list(active_adapters_attr)
            except TypeError:
                active_adapters = []

    payload = {
        "has_peft_config": hasattr(peft_model, "peft_config"),
        "active_adapters": active_adapters,
        "disable_adapter_layers": bool(getattr(getattr(peft_model, "base_model", None), "_disable_adapter", False)),
    }
    if extra:
        payload.update(extra)
    return payload


def _base_ref_probe_payload(stage: str, tensor: torch.Tensor, old_log_prob: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> dict:
    flat = tensor.reshape(-1)
    payload = {
        "stage": stage,
        "shape": list(tensor.shape),
        "dtype": str(tensor.dtype),
        "device": str(tensor.device),
        "mean": float(tensor.mean().item()),
        "abs_mean": float(tensor.abs().mean().item()),
        "min": float(tensor.min().item()),
        "max": float(tensor.max().item()),
        "head": flat[:8].detach().cpu().tolist(),
    }
    if old_log_prob is not None:
        diff = old_log_prob - tensor
        payload.update(
            {
                "old_mean": float(old_log_prob.mean().item()),
                "diff_mean": float(diff.mean().item()),
                "diff_abs_mean": float(diff.abs().mean().item()),
            }
        )
    return payload


class DataParallelPPOActor(BasePPOActor):
    """FSDP DataParallel PPO Actor or Ref worker

    Args:
        config (ActorConfig): Actor config
        actor_module (nn.Module): Actor or ref module
        actor_optimizer (torch.optim.Optimizer, optional): Actor optimizer. Defaults to None.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: ActorConfig, actor_module: nn.Module, actor_optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer = None):
        """When optimizer is None, it is Reference Policy"""
        super().__init__(config)
        self.actor_module = actor_module
        self.actor_optimizer = actor_optimizer
        self._grad_dump_done = False
        role = "Ref" if actor_optimizer is None else "Actor"

        self.use_remove_padding = self.config.get("use_remove_padding", False)
        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            print(f"{role} use_remove_padding={self.use_remove_padding}")
        self.use_fused_kernels = self.config.get("use_fused_kernels", False)
        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            print(f"{role} use_fused_kernels={self.use_fused_kernels}")

        self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size = self.config.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size
        self.use_ulysses_sp = self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size > 1

        if self.config.entropy_from_logits_with_chunking:
            entropy_from_logits = verl_F.entropy_from_logits_with_chunking
        else:
            entropy_from_logits = verl_F.entropy_from_logits

        self.compute_entropy_from_logits = (
            torch.compile(entropy_from_logits, dynamic=True)
            if self.config.get("use_torch_compile", True)  # use torch compile by default
            else entropy_from_logits
        )
        self.device_name = get_device_name()
        self.param_dtype = PrecisionType.to_dtype(self.config.fsdp_config.get("dtype", "bfloat16"))
        if self.param_dtype == torch.float16:
            from torch.distributed.fsdp.sharded_grad_scaler import ShardedGradScaler

            self.scaler = ShardedGradScaler(growth_interval=400)
        else:
            self.scaler = None

        self._adalora_step = 0
        self._debug_base_kl_once = False
        self._debug_base_ref_flow_once = False

    def _forward_micro_batch(
        self, micro_batch, temperature, calculate_entropy=False
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Returns:
            entropy: # (bs, response_len)
            log_probs: # (bs, response_len)
        """
        response_length = micro_batch["responses"].size(-1)
        multi_modal_inputs = {}
        if "multi_modal_inputs" in micro_batch.keys():
            from verl.utils.model import extract_multi_modal_inputs

            multi_modal_inputs = extract_multi_modal_inputs(micro_batch["multi_modal_inputs"])

        with torch.autocast(device_type=self.device_name, dtype=self.param_dtype):
            input_ids = micro_batch["input_ids"]
            batch_size, seqlen = input_ids.shape
            attention_mask = micro_batch["attention_mask"]
            position_ids = micro_batch["position_ids"]
            entropy = None
            if position_ids.dim() == 3:  # qwen2vl mrope
                position_ids = position_ids.transpose(0, 1)  # (bsz, 4, seqlen) -> (4, bsz, seqlen)

            if self.use_remove_padding:
                input_ids_rmpad, indices, cu_seqlens, *_ = unpad_input(
                    input_ids.unsqueeze(-1), attention_mask
                )  # input_ids_rmpad (total_nnz, ...)
                input_ids_rmpad = input_ids_rmpad.transpose(0, 1)  # (1, total_nnz)

                # unpad the position_ids to align the rotary
                if position_ids.dim() == 3:
                    position_ids_rmpad = (
                        index_first_axis(rearrange(position_ids, "c b s ... -> (b s) c ..."), indices)
                        .transpose(0, 1)
                        .unsqueeze(1)
                    )  # (4, bsz, seqlen) -> (4, 1, bsz * seqlen)
                else:
                    position_ids_rmpad = index_first_axis(
                        rearrange(position_ids.unsqueeze(-1), "b s ... -> (b s) ..."), indices
                    ).transpose(0, 1)

                is_mask_all_zero = attention_mask.sum() == 0
                if is_mask_all_zero:
                    input_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(
                        (1, self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size),
                        device=input_ids.device,
                        dtype=input_ids.dtype,
                    )
                    if position_ids.dim() == 3:
                        position_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(
                            (position_ids.shape[0], 1, self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size),
                            device=position_ids.device,
                            dtype=position_ids.dtype,
                        )
                    else:
                        position_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(
                            (1, self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size),
                            device=position_ids.device,
                            dtype=position_ids.dtype,
                        )

                if "image_bound" in multi_modal_inputs:
                    from verl.utils.dataset.vision_utils import process_multi_modal_inputs_for_minicpmo

                    multi_modal_inputs = process_multi_modal_inputs_for_minicpmo(
                        input_ids, attention_mask, position_ids, cu_seqlens, multi_modal_inputs
                    )

                # for compute the log_prob
                input_ids_rmpad_rolled = torch.roll(input_ids_rmpad, shifts=-1, dims=1)  # (1, total_nnz)

                # pad and slice the inputs if sp > 1
                if self.use_ulysses_sp:
                    is_vlm_model = hasattr(
                        getattr(self.actor_module, "module", self.actor_module).config, "vision_config"
                    )
                    if is_vlm_model:
                        # vlm model's inputs will be sliced after embedding
                        input_ids_rmpad, position_ids_rmpad, pad_size = ulysses_pad(
                            input_ids_rmpad,
                            position_ids_rmpad=position_ids_rmpad,
                            sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size,
                        )
                    else:
                        input_ids_rmpad, position_ids_rmpad, pad_size = ulysses_pad_and_slice_inputs(
                            input_ids_rmpad,
                            position_ids_rmpad=position_ids_rmpad,
                            sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size,
                        )
                    input_ids_rmpad_rolled, _, _ = ulysses_pad_and_slice_inputs(
                        input_ids_rmpad_rolled,
                        position_ids_rmpad=None,
                        sp_size=self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size,
                    )

                input_ids_rmpad_rolled = input_ids_rmpad_rolled.squeeze(0)  # ((total_nnz / sp) + pad)

                # only pass input_ids and position_ids to enable flash_attn_varlen
                extra_args = {}
                if self.use_fused_kernels:
                    extra_args["temperature"] = temperature
                    extra_args["return_dict"] = True

                output = self.actor_module(
                    input_ids=input_ids_rmpad,
                    attention_mask=None,
                    position_ids=position_ids_rmpad,
                    **multi_modal_inputs,
                    use_cache=False,
                    **extra_args,
                )  # prevent model thinks we are generating

                if self.use_fused_kernels:
                    log_probs = output.log_probs.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz,)
                    entropy_rmpad = output.entropy.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz,)

                else:
                    logits_rmpad = output.logits.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz, vocab_size)
                    logits_rmpad.div_(temperature)

                    # if use_sp: ((total_nnz / sp) + pad) ; if not use_sp: (batch, seqlen)
                    inplace_backward = True
                    if calculate_entropy:
                        inplace_backward = False
                    log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(
                        logits=logits_rmpad,
                        labels=input_ids_rmpad_rolled,
                        inplace_backward=inplace_backward,
                    )

                    # compute entropy
                    if calculate_entropy:
                        if not self.config.entropy_checkpointing:
                            entropy_rmpad = self.compute_entropy_from_logits(logits_rmpad)  # ((total_nnz / sp) + pad)
                        else:
                            entropy_rmpad = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(
                                self.compute_entropy_from_logits, logits_rmpad
                            )

                # gather log_prob if sp > 1
                if self.use_ulysses_sp:
                    # gather and unpad for the ulysses sp
                    log_probs = gather_outputs_and_unpad(
                        log_probs,
                        gather_dim=0,
                        unpad_dim=0,
                        padding_size=pad_size,
                    )
                    if calculate_entropy:
                        entropy_rmpad = gather_outputs_and_unpad(
                            entropy_rmpad,
                            gather_dim=0,
                            unpad_dim=0,
                            padding_size=pad_size,
                        )

                if is_mask_all_zero:
                    log_probs = log_probs[:0]
                    if calculate_entropy:
                        entropy_rmpad = entropy_rmpad[:0]

                # pad back to (bsz, seqlen)
                if calculate_entropy:
                    full_entropy = pad_input(
                        hidden_states=entropy_rmpad.unsqueeze(-1),
                        indices=indices,
                        batch=batch_size,
                        seqlen=seqlen,
                    )
                full_log_probs = pad_input(
                    hidden_states=log_probs.unsqueeze(-1),
                    indices=indices,
                    batch=batch_size,
                    seqlen=seqlen,
                )

                # only return response part:
                if calculate_entropy:
                    entropy = full_entropy.squeeze(-1)[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
                log_probs = full_log_probs.squeeze(-1)[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)

            else:  # not using rmpad and no ulysses sp
                extra_args = {}
                if self.use_fused_kernels:
                    extra_args["temperature"] = temperature
                    extra_args["return_dict"] = True

                output = self.actor_module(
                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    position_ids=position_ids,
                    **multi_modal_inputs,
                    use_cache=False,
                    **extra_args,
                )  # prevent model thinks we are generating

                if self.use_fused_kernels:
                    log_probs = output.log_probs[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]
                    entropy = output.entropy[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)

                else:
                    logits = output.logits

                    logits.div_(temperature)
                    logits = logits[:, -response_length - 1 : -1, :]  # (bsz, response_length, vocab_size)
                    log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(logits, micro_batch["responses"])
                    if calculate_entropy:
                        if not self.config.entropy_checkpointing:
                            entropy = verl_F.entropy_from_logits(logits)  # (bsz, response_length)
                        else:
                            entropy = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(verl_F.entropy_from_logits, logits)

            return entropy, log_probs

    def _optimizer_step(self):
        assert self.config.grad_clip is not None
        if self.scaler is not None:
            self.scaler.unscale_(self.actor_optimizer)
        if isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDP):
            grad_norm = self.actor_module.clip_grad_norm_(max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
        elif isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDPModule):
            grad_norm = fsdp2_clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_module.parameters(), max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
        else:
            grad_norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_module.parameters(), max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)

        if isinstance(grad_norm, DTensor):
            grad_norm = grad_norm.full_tensor()

        # if grad_norm is not finite, skip the update
        if self.scaler is not None:
            self.scaler.step(self.actor_optimizer)
            self.scaler.update()
        else:
            if not torch.isfinite(grad_norm):
                print(f"WARN: rank {torch.distributed.get_rank()} grad_norm is not finite: {grad_norm}")
                self.actor_optimizer.zero_grad()
            else:
                self.actor_optimizer.step()

        peft_model = getattr(self.actor_module, "_fsdp_wrapped_module", self.actor_module)
        peft_config = getattr(getattr(peft_model, "peft_config", {}), "get", lambda *_: None)("default")
        if peft_config is not None and str(getattr(peft_config, "peft_type", "")).endswith("ADALORA"):
            init_r = getattr(peft_config, "init_r", None)
            target_r = getattr(peft_config, "target_r", None)
            should_allocate = init_r is None or target_r is None or target_r < init_r
            if should_allocate:
                missing_grad_count = 0
                for name, param in peft_model.named_parameters():
                    if "lora_" in name and ".default" in name and param.grad is None:
                        # AdaLoRA rank allocation reads gradients even after optimizer.step().
                        param.grad = torch.zeros_like(param)
                        missing_grad_count += 1
                if missing_grad_count and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
                    print(f"Filled {missing_grad_count} missing AdaLoRA grads with zeros before rank allocation.")
                peft_model.base_model.update_and_allocate(self._adalora_step)
                self._adalora_step += 1
            elif self._adalora_step == 0 and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
                print("Skipping AdaLoRA rank allocation because target_r >= init_r; rank schedule is a no-op.")
                self._adalora_step += 1
        return grad_norm

    @GPUMemoryLogger(role="dp actor", logger=logger)
    def compute_log_prob(self, data: DataProto, calculate_entropy=False) -> torch.Tensor:
        if not hasattr(self, "_debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once"):
            self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once = False
        """Compute the log probability of the responses given input_ids, attention_mask and position_ids

        Args:
            data (DataProto): a DataProto containing keys

                ``input_ids``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64. Note that input_ids is the
                concatenation of prompt and response. Note that ``sequence_length = prompt_length + response_length``.

                ``attention_mask``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64.

                ``position_ids``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64.

                ``responses``:  tensor of shape [batch_size, response_length]. torch.int64.

        Returns:
            torch.Tensor: the log_prob tensor
        """
        # set to eval
        self.actor_module.eval()
        if not self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            _write_actor_policy_debug(
                "actor_compute_log_prob",
                {
                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                    **_actor_adapter_state_payload(self.actor_module),
                },
            )
            self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once = True

        micro_batch_size = data.meta_info["micro_batch_size"]
        temperature = data.meta_info["temperature"]  # temperature must be in the data.meta_info to avoid silent error
        use_dynamic_bsz = data.meta_info["use_dynamic_bsz"]
        has_multi_modal_inputs = "multi_modal_inputs" in data.non_tensor_batch.keys()
        select_keys = ["responses", "input_ids", "attention_mask", "position_ids"]
        non_tensor_select_keys = ["multi_modal_inputs"] if has_multi_modal_inputs else []

        data = data.select(batch_keys=select_keys, non_tensor_batch_keys=non_tensor_select_keys)

        if use_dynamic_bsz:
            max_token_len = data.meta_info["max_token_len"] * self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size
            micro_batches, batch_idx_list = prepare_dynamic_batch(data, max_token_len=max_token_len)
        else:
            micro_batches = data.split(micro_batch_size)

        log_probs_lst = []
        entropy_lst = []
        for micro_batch in micro_batches:
            micro_batch = micro_batch.to(get_device_id())
            model_inputs = {**micro_batch.batch, **micro_batch.non_tensor_batch}
            with torch.no_grad():
                entropy, log_probs = self._forward_micro_batch(
                    model_inputs, temperature=temperature, calculate_entropy=calculate_entropy
                )
            log_probs_lst.append(log_probs)
            if calculate_entropy:
                entropy_lst.append(entropy)

        log_probs = torch.concat(log_probs_lst, dim=0)
        entropys = None
        if calculate_entropy:
            entropys = torch.concat(entropy_lst, dim=0)

        if use_dynamic_bsz:
            log_probs = restore_dynamic_batch(log_probs, batch_idx_list)
            if calculate_entropy:
                entropys = restore_dynamic_batch(entropys, batch_idx_list)

        return log_probs, entropys

    def _maybe_dump_full_grads(self) -> None:
        dump_path = os.getenv("VERL_FULL_GRAD_DUMP_PATH")
        if not dump_path or self._grad_dump_done or not isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDP):
            return

        requested = os.getenv("VERL_FULL_GRAD_LAYERS", "").strip()
        selected = {name.strip() for name in requested.split(",") if name.strip()}
        grad_tensors = {}

        with FSDP.summon_full_params(self.actor_module, writeback=False, with_grads=True):
            for name, param in self.actor_module.named_parameters():
                if not name.endswith(".weight"):
                    continue
                if selected and name not in selected:
                    continue
                if param.grad is None:
                    continue
                grad_tensors[name] = param.grad.detach().cpu().float().clone()

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            parent = os.path.dirname(dump_path)
            if parent:
                os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
            torch.save(grad_tensors, dump_path)
            print(f"Saved {len(grad_tensors)} full gradients to {dump_path}")

        torch.distributed.barrier()
        self._grad_dump_done = True

    @GPUMemoryLogger(role="dp actor", logger=logger)
    def update_policy(self, data: DataProto):
        # make sure we are in training mode
        self.actor_module.train()
        if not hasattr(self, "_debug_actor_update_policy_once"):
            self._debug_actor_update_policy_once = False
        if not self._debug_actor_update_policy_once and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            _write_actor_policy_debug(
                "actor_update_policy",
                {
                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                    **_actor_adapter_state_payload(self.actor_module),
                },
            )
            self._debug_actor_update_policy_once = True

        temperature = data.meta_info["temperature"]  # temperature must be in the data.meta_info to avoid silent error

        select_keys = [
            "responses",
            "response_mask",
            "input_ids",
            "attention_mask",
            "position_ids",
            "old_log_probs",
            "advantages",
        ]
        if self.config.use_kl_loss:
            select_keys.append("ref_log_prob")
        safe_base_ref_log_prob = None
        if "base_ref_log_prob" in data.batch.keys():
            # TensorDict.select() corrupts this tensor in the current training path,
            # so carry a materialized copy across the selection boundary.
            safe_base_ref_log_prob = data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"].clone().contiguous()
        # Include pre-computed IS weights if present in batch
        # Weights are computed centrally in trainer and added to batch when algorithm.rollout_is=True
        if "rollout_is_weights" in data.batch.keys():
            select_keys.append("rollout_is_weights")
        # Include rollout_log_probs for computing rollout_corr metrics in bypass mode
        if "rollout_log_probs" in data.batch.keys():
            select_keys.append("rollout_log_probs")

        has_multi_modal_inputs = "multi_modal_inputs" in data.non_tensor_batch.keys()
        non_tensor_select_keys = ["multi_modal_inputs"] if has_multi_modal_inputs else []

        data = data.select(batch_keys=select_keys, non_tensor_batch_keys=non_tensor_select_keys)
        if safe_base_ref_log_prob is not None:
            data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"] = safe_base_ref_log_prob
        if (
            not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
            and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
            and "base_ref_log_prob" in data.batch.keys()
        ):
            _write_base_kl_debug(
                "actor_update_probe_after_select",
                {
                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                    **_base_ref_probe_payload(
                        "after_select",
                        data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"],
                        data.batch.get("old_log_probs"),
                    ),
                },
            )

        # Split to make minibatch iterator for updating the actor
        # See PPO paper for details. https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347
        mini_batches = data.split(self.config.ppo_mini_batch_size)

        on_policy = len(mini_batches) == 1 and self.config.ppo_epochs == 1

        metrics = {}
        for _ in range(self.config.ppo_epochs):
            for batch_idx, mini_batch in enumerate(mini_batches):
                if (
                    not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
                    and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
                    and "base_ref_log_prob" in mini_batch.batch.keys()
                ):
                    _write_base_kl_debug(
                        "actor_update_probe_mini_batch",
                        {
                            "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                            "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                            "mini_batch_idx": int(batch_idx),
                            **_base_ref_probe_payload(
                                "mini_batch_before_dynamic",
                                mini_batch.batch["base_ref_log_prob"],
                                mini_batch.batch.get("old_log_probs"),
                            ),
                        },
                    )
                if self.config.use_dynamic_bsz:
                    max_token_len = self.config.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu * self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size
                    micro_batches, _ = prepare_dynamic_batch(mini_batch, max_token_len=max_token_len)
                else:
                    self.gradient_accumulation = (
                        self.config.ppo_mini_batch_size // self.config.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu
                    )
                    micro_batches = mini_batch.split(self.config.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu)

                self.actor_optimizer.zero_grad()

                for micro_idx, micro_batch in enumerate(micro_batches):
                    if (
                        not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
                        and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
                        and "base_ref_log_prob" in micro_batch.batch.keys()
                    ):
                        _write_base_kl_debug(
                            "actor_update_probe_micro_before_to",
                            {
                                "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                                "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                                "mini_batch_idx": int(batch_idx),
                                "micro_batch_idx": int(micro_idx),
                                **_base_ref_probe_payload(
                                    "micro_batch_before_to",
                                    micro_batch.batch["base_ref_log_prob"],
                                    micro_batch.batch.get("old_log_probs"),
                                ),
                            },
                        )
                    micro_batch = micro_batch.to(get_device_id())
                    micro_batch_metrics = {}
                    model_inputs = {**micro_batch.batch, **micro_batch.non_tensor_batch}
                    if (
                        not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
                        and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
                        and "base_ref_log_prob" in model_inputs
                    ):
                        _write_base_kl_debug(
                            "actor_update_probe_micro_after_to",
                            {
                                "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                                "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                                "mini_batch_idx": int(batch_idx),
                                "micro_batch_idx": int(micro_idx),
                                **_base_ref_probe_payload(
                                    "micro_batch_after_to",
                                    model_inputs["base_ref_log_prob"],
                                    model_inputs.get("old_log_probs"),
                                ),
                            },
                        )
                        self._debug_base_ref_flow_once = True
                    response_mask = model_inputs["response_mask"]
                    old_log_prob = model_inputs["old_log_probs"]
                    advantages = model_inputs["advantages"]

                    entropy_coeff = self.config.entropy_coeff
                    loss_agg_mode = self.config.loss_agg_mode

                    calculate_entropy = self.config.calculate_entropy or (entropy_coeff != 0)

                    if self.config.use_dynamic_bsz:
                        loss_scale_factor = response_mask.shape[0] / self.config.ppo_mini_batch_size
                    else:
                        loss_scale_factor = 1 / self.gradient_accumulation

                    # all return: (bsz, response_length)
                    entropy, log_prob = self._forward_micro_batch(
                        model_inputs, temperature=temperature, calculate_entropy=calculate_entropy
                    )

                    # Keep rollout/eval-mode log probs for diagnostics such as base-model KL.
                    rollout_old_log_prob = model_inputs["old_log_probs"]
                    # for fully_async_policy recipe
                    if hasattr(self.config, "use_rollout_log_probs") and self.config.use_rollout_log_probs:
                        old_log_prob = rollout_old_log_prob
                    else:
                        if on_policy:
                            old_log_prob = log_prob.detach()
                        else:
                            old_log_prob = rollout_old_log_prob

                    loss_mode = self.config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")
                    # vanilla -> verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.compute_policy_loss_vanilla

                    # Extract pre-computed rollout correction weights if present
                    # Weights are computed centrally in trainer and added when algorithm.rollout_is=True
                    rollout_is_weights = model_inputs.get("rollout_is_weights", None)

                    # gpg -> verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.compute_policy_loss_gpg
                    # clip_cov -> verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.compute_policy_loss_clip_cov
                    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)

                    # Compute policy loss (any function is expected to return 2 values)
                    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
                        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
                        log_prob=log_prob,
                        advantages=advantages,
                        response_mask=response_mask,
                        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
                        config=self.config,
                        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
                    )
                    micro_batch_metrics.update(pg_metrics)

                    # Skip if using pure rollout correction mode (metrics already in pg_metrics)
                    rollout_log_prob = model_inputs.get("rollout_log_probs", None)
                    if loss_mode != "rollout_correction" and rollout_log_prob is not None:
                        # Compute metrics using CURRENT policy π_θ vs π_rollout
                        # Tracks evolving off-policy gap as π_θ updates during mini-batch training
                        from verl.trainer.ppo.rollout_corr_helper import compute_rollout_corr_metrics_from_logprobs

                        rollout_corr_metrics = compute_rollout_corr_metrics_from_logprobs(
                            log_prob=log_prob,
                            rollout_log_prob=rollout_log_prob,
                            response_mask=response_mask,
                        )
                        micro_batch_metrics.update(rollout_corr_metrics)

                    policy_loss = pg_loss
                    if calculate_entropy and entropy is not None:
                        entropy_agg = agg_loss(loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)
                        micro_batch_metrics["actor/entropy"] = entropy_agg.detach().item()
                        if entropy_coeff != 0:
                            policy_loss -= entropy_agg * entropy_coeff

                    if self.config.use_kl_loss:
                        ref_log_prob = model_inputs["ref_log_prob"]
                        # compute kl loss
                        kld = kl_penalty(
                            logprob=log_prob, ref_logprob=ref_log_prob, kl_penalty=self.config.kl_loss_type
                        )
                        kl_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=kld, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)

                        policy_loss = policy_loss + kl_loss * self.config.kl_loss_coef
                        micro_batch_metrics["actor/kl_loss"] = kl_loss.detach().item() * loss_scale_factor
                        micro_batch_metrics["actor/kl_coef"] = self.config.kl_loss_coef

                    if "base_ref_log_prob" in model_inputs:
                        base_ref_log_prob = model_inputs["base_ref_log_prob"]
                        # Compare rollout/eval-mode policy log probs against the frozen reference.
                        # This keeps base-model KL on the same inference-style footing as standard LoRA evals.
                        negative_approx_base_kl = torch.clamp(
                            rollout_old_log_prob - base_ref_log_prob, min=-20.0, max=20.0
                        )
                        base_model_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_base_kl, response_mask)
                        micro_batch_metrics["actor/base_model_kl"] = base_model_kl.detach().item()
                        global_step = int(data.meta_info.get("global_steps", -1))
                        if not self._debug_base_kl_once and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
                            self._debug_base_kl_once = True
                            rollout_vs_current = rollout_old_log_prob - log_prob.detach()
                            current_vs_base = log_prob.detach() - base_ref_log_prob
                            debug_payload = {
                                "stage": "actor_update",
                                "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
                                "global_step": global_step,
                                "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
                                "mini_batch_idx": int(batch_idx),
                                "micro_batch_idx": int(micro_idx),
                                **_debug_base_kl_payload(rollout_old_log_prob, base_ref_log_prob, response_mask),
                                "current_log_prob_mean": float(log_prob.detach().mean().item()),
                                "rollout_vs_current_diff_mean": float(rollout_vs_current.mean().item()),
                                "rollout_vs_current_diff_abs_mean": float(rollout_vs_current.abs().mean().item()),
                                "current_vs_base_diff_mean": float(current_vs_base.mean().item()),
                                "current_vs_base_diff_abs_mean": float(current_vs_base.abs().mean().item()),
                            }
                            debug_path = _write_base_kl_debug("actor_update", debug_payload)
                            print(f"[DEBUG actor-update base KL] wrote {debug_path}")

                    if self.config.use_dynamic_bsz:
                        # relative to the dynamic bsz
                        loss = policy_loss * loss_scale_factor
                    else:
                        loss = policy_loss * loss_scale_factor
                    if self.scaler is not None:
                        self.scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                    else:
                        loss.backward()

                    micro_batch_metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = pg_loss.detach().item() * loss_scale_factor
                    append_to_dict(metrics, micro_batch_metrics)

                self._maybe_dump_full_grads()
                grad_norm = self._optimizer_step()
                mini_batch_metrics = {"actor/grad_norm": grad_norm.detach().item()}
                append_to_dict(metrics, mini_batch_metrics)
        self.actor_optimizer.zero_grad()
        return metrics

299	                output = self.actor_module(
300	                    input_ids=input_ids_rmpad,
301	                    attention_mask=None,
302	                    position_ids=position_ids_rmpad,
303	                    **multi_modal_inputs,
304	                    use_cache=False,
305	                    **extra_args,
306	                )  # prevent model thinks we are generating
307	
308	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
309	                    log_probs = output.log_probs.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz,)
310	                    entropy_rmpad = output.entropy.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz,)
311	
312	                else:
313	                    logits_rmpad = output.logits.squeeze(0)  # (total_nnz, vocab_size)
314	                    logits_rmpad.div_(temperature)
315	
316	                    # if use_sp: ((total_nnz / sp) + pad) ; if not use_sp: (batch, seqlen)
317	                    inplace_backward = True
318	                    if calculate_entropy:
319	                        inplace_backward = False
320	                    log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(
321	                        logits=logits_rmpad,
322	                        labels=input_ids_rmpad_rolled,
323	                        inplace_backward=inplace_backward,
324	                    )
325	
326	                    # compute entropy
327	                    if calculate_entropy:
328	                        if not self.config.entropy_checkpointing:
329	                            entropy_rmpad = self.compute_entropy_from_logits(logits_rmpad)  # ((total_nnz / sp) + pad)
330	                        else:
331	                            entropy_rmpad = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(
332	                                self.compute_entropy_from_logits, logits_rmpad
333	                            )
334	
335	                # gather log_prob if sp > 1
336	                if self.use_ulysses_sp:
337	                    # gather and unpad for the ulysses sp
338	                    log_probs = gather_outputs_and_unpad(
339	                        log_probs,
340	                        gather_dim=0,
341	                        unpad_dim=0,
342	                        padding_size=pad_size,
343	                    )
344	                    if calculate_entropy:
345	                        entropy_rmpad = gather_outputs_and_unpad(
346	                            entropy_rmpad,
347	                            gather_dim=0,
348	                            unpad_dim=0,
349	                            padding_size=pad_size,
350	                        )
351	
352	                if is_mask_all_zero:
353	                    log_probs = log_probs[:0]
354	                    if calculate_entropy:
355	                        entropy_rmpad = entropy_rmpad[:0]
356	
357	                # pad back to (bsz, seqlen)
358	                if calculate_entropy:
359	                    full_entropy = pad_input(
360	                        hidden_states=entropy_rmpad.unsqueeze(-1),
361	                        indices=indices,
362	                        batch=batch_size,
363	                        seqlen=seqlen,
364	                    )
365	                full_log_probs = pad_input(
366	                    hidden_states=log_probs.unsqueeze(-1),
367	                    indices=indices,
368	                    batch=batch_size,
369	                    seqlen=seqlen,
370	                )
371	
372	                # only return response part:
373	                if calculate_entropy:
374	                    entropy = full_entropy.squeeze(-1)[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
375	                log_probs = full_log_probs.squeeze(-1)[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
376	
377	            else:  # not using rmpad and no ulysses sp
378	                extra_args = {}
379	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
380	                    extra_args["temperature"] = temperature
381	                    extra_args["return_dict"] = True
382	
383	                output = self.actor_module(
384	                    input_ids=input_ids,
385	                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
386	                    position_ids=position_ids,
387	                    **multi_modal_inputs,
388	                    use_cache=False,
389	                    **extra_args,
390	                )  # prevent model thinks we are generating
391	
392	                if self.use_fused_kernels:
393	                    log_probs = output.log_probs[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]
394	                    entropy = output.entropy[:, -response_length - 1 : -1]  # (bsz, response_length)
395	
396	                else:
397	                    logits = output.logits
398	
399	                    logits.div_(temperature)
400	                    logits = logits[:, -response_length - 1 : -1, :]  # (bsz, response_length, vocab_size)
401	                    log_probs = logprobs_from_logits(logits, micro_batch["responses"])
402	                    if calculate_entropy:
403	                        if not self.config.entropy_checkpointing:
404	                            entropy = verl_F.entropy_from_logits(logits)  # (bsz, response_length)
405	                        else:
406	                            entropy = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(verl_F.entropy_from_logits, logits)
407	
408	            return entropy, log_probs

410	    def _optimizer_step(self):
411	        assert self.config.grad_clip is not None
412	        if self.scaler is not None:
413	            self.scaler.unscale_(self.actor_optimizer)
414	        if isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDP):
415	            grad_norm = self.actor_module.clip_grad_norm_(max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
416	        elif isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDPModule):
417	            grad_norm = fsdp2_clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_module.parameters(), max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
418	        else:
419	            grad_norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.actor_module.parameters(), max_norm=self.config.grad_clip)
420	
421	        if isinstance(grad_norm, DTensor):
422	            grad_norm = grad_norm.full_tensor()
423	
424	        # if grad_norm is not finite, skip the update
425	        if self.scaler is not None:
426	            self.scaler.step(self.actor_optimizer)
427	            self.scaler.update()
428	        else:
429	            if not torch.isfinite(grad_norm):
430	                print(f"WARN: rank {torch.distributed.get_rank()} grad_norm is not finite: {grad_norm}")
431	                self.actor_optimizer.zero_grad()
432	            else:
433	                self.actor_optimizer.step()
434	
435	        peft_model = getattr(self.actor_module, "_fsdp_wrapped_module", self.actor_module)
436	        peft_config = getattr(getattr(peft_model, "peft_config", {}), "get", lambda *_: None)("default")
437	        if peft_config is not None and str(getattr(peft_config, "peft_type", "")).endswith("ADALORA"):
438	            init_r = getattr(peft_config, "init_r", None)
439	            target_r = getattr(peft_config, "target_r", None)
440	            should_allocate = init_r is None or target_r is None or target_r < init_r
441	            if should_allocate:
442	                missing_grad_count = 0
443	                for name, param in peft_model.named_parameters():
444	                    if "lora_" in name and ".default" in name and param.grad is None:
445	                        # AdaLoRA rank allocation reads gradients even after optimizer.step().
446	                        param.grad = torch.zeros_like(param)
447	                        missing_grad_count += 1
448	                if missing_grad_count and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
449	                    print(f"Filled {missing_grad_count} missing AdaLoRA grads with zeros before rank allocation.")
450	                peft_model.base_model.update_and_allocate(self._adalora_step)
451	                self._adalora_step += 1
452	            elif self._adalora_step == 0 and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
453	                print("Skipping AdaLoRA rank allocation because target_r >= init_r; rank schedule is a no-op.")
454	                self._adalora_step += 1
455	        return grad_norm

457	    @GPUMemoryLogger(role="dp actor", logger=logger)
458	    def compute_log_prob(self, data: DataProto, calculate_entropy=False) -> torch.Tensor:
459	        if not hasattr(self, "_debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once"):
460	            self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once = False
461	        """Compute the log probability of the responses given input_ids, attention_mask and position_ids
462	
463	        Args:
464	            data (DataProto): a DataProto containing keys
465	
466	                ``input_ids``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64. Note that input_ids is the
467	                concatenation of prompt and response. Note that ``sequence_length = prompt_length + response_length``.
468	
469	                ``attention_mask``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64.
470	
471	                ``position_ids``: tensor of shape [batch_size, sequence_length]. torch.int64.
472	
473	                ``responses``:  tensor of shape [batch_size, response_length]. torch.int64.
474	
475	        Returns:
476	            torch.Tensor: the log_prob tensor
477	        """
478	        # set to eval
479	        self.actor_module.eval()
480	        if not self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
481	            _write_actor_policy_debug(
482	                "actor_compute_log_prob",
483	                {
484	                    "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),
485	                    "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
486	                    **_actor_adapter_state_payload(self.actor_module),
487	                },
488	            )
489	            self._debug_actor_compute_log_prob_once = True
490	
491	        micro_batch_size = data.meta_info["micro_batch_size"]
492	        temperature = data.meta_info["temperature"]  # temperature must be in the data.meta_info to avoid silent error
493	        use_dynamic_bsz = data.meta_info["use_dynamic_bsz"]
494	        has_multi_modal_inputs = "multi_modal_inputs" in data.non_tensor_batch.keys()
495	        select_keys = ["responses", "input_ids", "attention_mask", "position_ids"]
496	        non_tensor_select_keys = ["multi_modal_inputs"] if has_multi_modal_inputs else []
497	
498	        data = data.select(batch_keys=select_keys, non_tensor_batch_keys=non_tensor_select_keys)
499	
500	        if use_dynamic_bsz:
501	            max_token_len = data.meta_info["max_token_len"] * self.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size
502	            micro_batches, batch_idx_list = prepare_dynamic_batch(data, max_token_len=max_token_len)
503	        else:
504	            micro_batches = data.split(micro_batch_size)
505	
506	        log_probs_lst = []
507	        entropy_lst = []
508	        for micro_batch in micro_batches:
509	            micro_batch = micro_batch.to(get_device_id())
510	            model_inputs = {**micro_batch.batch, **micro_batch.non_tensor_batch}
511	            with torch.no_grad():
512	                entropy, log_probs = self._forward_micro_batch(
513	                    model_inputs, temperature=temperature, calculate_entropy=calculate_entropy
514	                )
515	            log_probs_lst.append(log_probs)
516	            if calculate_entropy:
517	                entropy_lst.append(entropy)
518	
519	        log_probs = torch.concat(log_probs_lst, dim=0)
520	        entropys = None
521	        if calculate_entropy:
522	            entropys = torch.concat(entropy_lst, dim=0)
523	
524	        if use_dynamic_bsz:
525	            log_probs = restore_dynamic_batch(log_probs, batch_idx_list)
526	            if calculate_entropy:
527	                entropys = restore_dynamic_batch(entropys, batch_idx_list)
528	
529	        return log_probs, entropys

531	    def _maybe_dump_full_grads(self) -> None:
532	        dump_path = os.getenv("VERL_FULL_GRAD_DUMP_PATH")
533	        if not dump_path or self._grad_dump_done or not isinstance(self.actor_module, FSDP):
534	            return
535	
536	        requested = os.getenv("VERL_FULL_GRAD_LAYERS", "").strip()
537	        selected = {name.strip() for name in requested.split(",") if name.strip()}
538	        grad_tensors = {}
539	
540	        with FSDP.summon_full_params(self.actor_module, writeback=False, with_grads=True):
541	            for name, param in self.actor_module.named_parameters():
542	                if not name.endswith(".weight"):
543	                    continue
544	                if selected and name not in selected:
545	                    continue
546	                if param.grad is None:
547	                    continue
548	                grad_tensors[name] = param.grad.detach().cpu().float().clone()
549	
550	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
551	            parent = os.path.dirname(dump_path)
552	            if parent:
553	                os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
554	            torch.save(grad_tensors, dump_path)
555	            print(f"Saved {len(grad_tensors)} full gradients to {dump_path}")
556	
557	        torch.distributed.barrier()
558	        self._grad_dump_done = True

578

605	
606	        data = data.select(batch_keys=select_keys, non_tensor_batch_keys=non_tensor_select_keys)
607	        if safe_base_ref_log_prob is not None:

609	        if (
610	            not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
611	            and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
612	            and "base_ref_log_prob" in data.batch.keys()
613	        ):
614	            _write_base_kl_debug(

619	                    **_base_ref_probe_payload(

621	                        data.batch["base_ref_log_prob"],
622	                        data.batch.get("old_log_probs"),
623	                    ),
624	                },

627	        # Split to make minibatch iterator for updating the actor
628	        # See PPO paper for details. https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347
629	        mini_batches = data.split(self.config.ppo_mini_batch_size)
630	
631	        on_policy = len(mini_batches) == 1 and self.config.ppo_epochs == 1
632	
633	        metrics = {}
634	        for _ in range(self.config.ppo_epochs):
635	            for batch_idx, mini_batch in enumerate(mini_batches):
636	                if (
637	                    not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
638	                    and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
639	                    and "base_ref_log_prob" in mini_batch.batch.keys()
640	                ):
641	                    _write_base_kl_debug(
642	                        "actor_update_probe_mini_batch",

645	                            "rank": int(torch.distributed.get_rank()),
646	                            "mini_batch_idx": int(batch_idx),

665	                for micro_idx, micro_batch in enumerate(micro_batches):

667	                        not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once
668	                        and torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0
669	                        and "base_ref_log_prob" in micro_batch.batch.keys()
670	                    ):
671	                        _write_base_kl_debug(
672	                            "actor_update_probe_micro_before_to",
673	                            {
674	                                "experiment_name": str(data.meta_info.get("experiment_name", "unknown_exp")),

682	                                ),
683	                            },

688	                    if (
689	                        not self._debug_base_ref_flow_once

691	                        and "base_ref_log_prob" in model_inputs
692	                    ):
693	                        _write_base_kl_debug(
694	                            "actor_update_probe_micro_after_to",
695	                            {

705	                            },

708	                    response_mask = model_inputs["response_mask"]
709	                    old_log_prob = model_inputs["old_log_probs"]
710	                    advantages = model_inputs["advantages"]
711	
712	                    entropy_coeff = self.config.entropy_coeff
713	                    loss_agg_mode = self.config.loss_agg_mode
714	
715	                    calculate_entropy = self.config.calculate_entropy or (entropy_coeff != 0)
716	
717	                    if self.config.use_dynamic_bsz:

719	                    else:
720	                        loss_scale_factor = 1 / self.gradient_accumulation
721	
722	                    # all return: (bsz, response_length)
723	                    entropy, log_prob = self._forward_micro_batch(
724	                        model_inputs, temperature=temperature, calculate_entropy=calculate_entropy
725	                    )
726	
727	                    # Keep rollout/eval-mode log probs for diagnostics such as base-model KL.

729	                    # for fully_async_policy recipe
730	                    if hasattr(self.config, "use_rollout_log_probs") and self.config.use_rollout_log_probs:

732	                    else:
733	                        if on_policy:
